articles.title: Emerson Schedules First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
articles.mainIdea: Emerson Schedules First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Emerson Schedules First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call. Emerson (NYSE: EMR) will report its first quarter results after market close on Tuesday, February 3, 2026. Emerson senior management will discuss the results during an investor conference call that same day, beginning at 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time, 3:30 p.m. Central Time.

articles.title: RISA Labs Closes $11.1M Series A to Scale AI Operating System for Oncology Nationwide
articles.mainIdea: RISA Labs Closes $11.1M Series A to Scale AI Operating System for Oncology Nationwide
articles.summary: PR Newswire: RISA Labs Closes $11.1M Series A to Scale AI Operating System for Oncology Nationwide. RISA Labs, a company pioneering an AI operating system for oncology, today announced the closing of an $11.1 million Series A funding round. The financing was co-led by Cencora Ventures and Optum Ventures, with participation from Oncology Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and John Simon (co-founder of General Catalyst) via his Ventureforgood investment entity.
